Cost of service and rate design study
Entergy disclosed a large-load pipeline of 10-17 GW above base case and an ESA backlog up about 85% since 2024, but gave no absolute signed-ESA figure; the 2026-2030 capital plan is $67bn

Entergy's disclosure is structurally different from its peers: it quantifies the pipeline as an incremental range above base case rather than a contracted ladder, and states signed ESAs only as a percentage increase. Signed volume is therefore visible in the capital plan and the ~9% retail sales CAGR rather than in a GW figure. Contracts run 15-20 years with minimum bills and early-termination fees.
